verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents three quantization techniques (PQ, RaBitQ, SQ) explicitly for compressing vector indexes to save memory/storage, with dedicated docs on vector indexing and reindexing. However missing for 10: no documented accuracy/recall trade-off benchmarks or guidance quantifying the accuracy loss per technique, no independent/hands-on corroboration of the trade-off, and no worked example showing memory savings vs recall impact.
